description: Step 2 of 2. Applies the pickup outcome prepared by confirm_pickup. Call this ONLY after the seller has said yes to that buyer and outcome. Pass the same action you prepared; the server refuses a different one (CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH). This cannot be undone from here: "sold" marks the items sold and emails the buyer; "noshow" cancels the reservation and may tell the next queued buyer it is their turn. If the result says retryable: true, some items were not written yet and the reservation is still open: call finalize_pickup again with the same token. A token is valid for ten minutes; if it has expired, run confirm_pickup again and get the seller's yes before retrying.

action.description: The action confirm_pickup prepared and the seller approved. Shown in your approval prompt; must match.

reservation_id.description: The same reservation_id you passed to confirm_pickup.
